x-e-m1-01.title: Ben ayeke ga na fête? Ti bâ sens ti ahide ti réponses ti lo
x-e-m1-01.goal: Divisé réponses ti Ben na dialogue ligne na ligne, fa ndulu ti ye so a zia décision ti ni na ye so angbâ, na zia jugement na ndulu ti tene 'lo ayeke ga' wala 'lo ayeke ga pëpe'.
x-e-m1-01.material:
Dialogue ti Jisu na Ben (a gbâ ni na texte gï, image ayeke pëpe):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.

x-e-m1-01.prereq.0: Sens ti expressions ti nzoni tongana might, probably na check with
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.prompt: Diko dialogue ti ga na nzoroko na yôro jugement so alingbi ahon ti so Ben ayeke ga na fête wala pëpe.

x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.b: Ni ayeke jugement so afa ndulu ti ye so aga na problème ti ngoi na ye so angbâ.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.c: Match ti soccer ayeke na matin na fête ayeke na 4 p.m. Mû pene pene ngoi use na ndö oko.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.d: 'Tired' ayeke souci so Ben asara addition ni lo même. Bâ so mo lingbi ti diko ni gï tongana refus.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.explain: Match ti soccer ayeke na matin na fête ayeke na 4 p.m., ni la ngoi use asara chevauchement pëpe. Ben atene gï so lo alingbi ti ayeke fatigué, na na nzoroko lo atene lo ayeke vérifier na maman ti lo kozo. Ni la ye ayeke so a zia décision ti ni (ngoi) na ye ayeke so angbâ (permission ti maman ti lo), na ni a zia décision ti ni pëpe awe.

x-e-m1-05.s.s1.o.b: Ti sara essai ti hunda arecommandations ti musique so bébé alingbi ti aye
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.r.b: Bébé a fa ni, me wara na note so ni ahunda arecommandations ti musique wala ape.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.o.c: Ti hunda na douceur ti kete son pekoni ti heure 9
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.r.c: Ni ayeke jugement so akaï ye so aparties ota ti note (salutation, éloge, tënë ti bébé) asara.
